items.source: payload - the Object to use as payload
Extends MessageSendingOperations and adds operations for sending messages to a destination specified as a (resolvable) String name.
items.translation: 扩展MessageSendingOperations，并添加向指定为（可解析）String 名称的目标发送消息的操作。

items.source: Resolve the given destination name to a destination, convert the payload Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, wrap it as a message and send it to the resolved destination.
items.translation: 将给定的目标名称解析为目标，使用`MessageConverter`（可能）将负载对象转换为序列化形式，将其封装为消息并发送到解析后的目标。

items.source: Resolve the given destination name to a destination, convert the payload Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, wrap it as a message with the given headers and send it to the resolved destination.
items.translation: 将给定的目标名称解析为目标，将负载对象转换为序列化形式（可能使用MessageConverter），将其包装为带有给定标头的消息，并发送到解析后的目标。

items.source: Resolve the given destination name to a destination, convert the payload Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, wrap it as a message with the given headers, apply the given post-processor, and send the resulting message to the resolved destination.
items.translation: 将给定的目标名称解析为目标，使用MessageConverter（如有）将负载对象转换为序列化形式，将其包装为带有给定标头的消息，应用给定的后置处理器，并将生成的消息发送到解析后的目标。

items.source: Resolve the given destination name to a destination, convert the payload Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, wrap it as a message, apply the given post-processor, and send the resulting message to the resolved destination.
items.translation: 将给定的目标名称解析为目标，将负载对象转换为序列化形式（可能使用MessageConverter），将其封装为消息，应用给定的后置处理器，并将生成的消息发送到解析后的目标。

items.source: Resolve the given destination name to a destination and send a message to it.
items.translation: 将给定的目标名称解析为目标并发送消息到该目标。

items.source: headers - the headers for the message to send
postProcessor - the post-processor to apply to the message
items.translation: postProcessor - 要应用于消息的后处理器
